bio.text: Victoria Broderick is the Democratic candidate for Tennessee's 4th Congressional District in 2026, challenging Republican Rep. Scott DesJarlais; the Tennessee Lookout calls her a two-time candidate.
According to the Tennessee Lookout, she is a Tennessee native who has worked in logistics and the technology industry and has served as chair of the Lincoln County Democratic Party.
